root_cause.text: The `efivar_entry_get()` function in the `efivarfs` subsystem masks errors by unconditionally returning success instead of propagating the failure status from the underlying `__efivar_entry_get()` call.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the modification from `return 0;` to `return err;` in `fs/efivarfs/vars.c`, correcting the behavior described in the CVE where `efivar_entry_get()` "always returns success even if the underlying __efivar_entry_get() fails," which previously allowed uninitialized heap memory to be copied to userspace.
